jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Halifax School District, a town school district in the Windham Southwest Supervisory Union (member town: Halifax).

sources.note: Halifax School Board page (Windham Southwest SU, official), terms verbatim: Paul Blais (Chair, 3-year term expires 2029), Wade Ryan (Vice Chair, expires 2028), Cassandra McLaren (Clerk, expires 2028). The same three reorganize the board in the March 11, 2026 minutes and sit in the June 17, 2026 minutes. The board is the section 423(a) default three directors at-large; the district's January 23, 2025 warning put two seats up together (the stagger), won by Ryan and McLaren.
